## What you want to improve or learn

Write this issue in English; simple wording is welcome. Describe your idea or the step where you got stuck. For a coverage proposal, explain the risk and link the closest existing case.

## Proposed scope

Describe a small first change, the files you think are involved and what you need to investigate. You do not need an implementation to start this discussion.

## How we would check the contribution

Describe the expected outcome and the evidence a reviewer would need. For a question, explain what you tried and what help you need.

## AI use (if applicable)

Describe what you want to practice with an assistant and how you would verify its suggestions. You can participate without AI.

## Impact on the demo (if applicable)

State whether the proposal would create data, affect shared state or need your own deployment.
